messages.content: Give me the MTBI of my friend.

function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content:
I’m happy to help you figure out your friend’s MBTI profile!  
To do so accurately I’ll need some information about how they score on each of the key personality dimensions:

| Dimension | Typical Traits |
|-----------|----------------|
| **E** vs **I** – Extraversion / Introversion |
| **S** vs **N** – Sensing / Intuition |
| **T** vs **F** – Thinking / Feeling |
| **J** vs **P** – Judging / Perceiving |

If you can give me approximate percentages (or just say which side feels stronger) for each dimension—e.g., “70 % introvert,” “55 % intuitive” etc.—I’ll run an assessment and tell you their likely MBTI type along with a brief interpretation.

Feel free to share whatever details you’re comfortable with, and we’ll get started!
